countAudit.finding: Finalized at 66 distinct mapped questions after the recorded source, stem/option and explanation review; no official examination weighting claimed.

reviewedImprovements.action: Added ischemic versus nonischemic CMR pattern comparison and limitations; no separate question needed for the same immediate diagnostic decision.
Replaced qualitative functional findings with measured CFR and IMR; added method-specific thresholds and spasm comparison without duplicating the existing endotype decision.

decisionsRequiringCoverageAssessment.issue: Check whether CCTA versus functional testing selection is sufficiently covered in Cardiology 1; avoid omitting it merely because this chapter already has 64 questions.
decisionsRequiringCoverageAssessment.disposition: Covered in Cardiology Chapter 1 questions 35–38 and 43–44; no duplicate added here.

decisionsRequiringCoverageAssessment.issue: Assess need for a distinct stent-thrombosis versus restenosis question beyond procedure-related MI classification.
decisionsRequiringCoverageAssessment.disposition: Added question 58 on imaging-defined stent failure; separate from MI category question 4.

decisionsRequiringCoverageAssessment.issue: Check whether changing-risk interpretation adds enough reasoning beyond immediate invasive indications to retain both.
decisionsRequiringCoverageAssessment.disposition: Retain questions 25 and 27: initial electrical instability versus deterioration despite a lower admission score test different use of risk prediction.

decisionsRequiringCoverageAssessment.issue: Assess explicit coverage of bleeding-risk criteria, abbreviated DAPT selection and de-escalation rather than relying solely on default duration.
decisionsRequiringCoverageAssessment.disposition: Added ARC-HBR interpretation question 38; existing DAPT question now 39 teaches abbreviated strategies and retained agent.

decisionsRequiringCoverageAssessment.issue: Check that the explanation teaches major absolute and relative contraindications beyond the tested prior intracranial hemorrhage.
decisionsRequiringCoverageAssessment.disposition: Question 19 now includes a compact 2025 ACC/AHA absolute/relative contraindication table with stroke, trauma, surgery, hypertension and bleeding windows. No duplicate question needed for the same screening decision.

countAudit.completionRule: Record disposition for each coverage gap, complete source and editorial review, then finalize count. Structural validation alone does not close this audit.
